Black Friday Shortwave Radio Deals

Black Friday and Cyber Monday are the best time of year to buy a shortwave radio, and a radio makes a great gift for anyone curious about what's on the air. These are the radios worth buying on sale, who each one suits, and how to tell a real deal from a fake one.

We don't list prices here because Amazon's change by the hour. Every button opens the live listing, so you see today's real price.

Don't forget an antenna

The cheapest upgrade for any portable is a few meters of wire clipped to the antenna jack. It often makes more difference than the radio itself. Shortwave wire antenna kits on Amazon. For apartments, see our antenna guide.

How to tell if it's a real deal

  • Check the price history. Free tools like camelcamelcamel and Keepa show what an Amazon listing has actually sold for. A "40% off" sale is no deal if the price was raised the week before.
  • Ignore the "List Price." The crossed-out price is often a number the radio rarely sells for.
  • Check who's selling it. Look for the brand's own store or Amazon itself, so returns and warranty are easy.
  • Match the model exactly. Similar names hide different radios. Make sure the listing says the exact model, and whether a battery is included.
  • Check the return date. Holiday orders often get a longer return window. Your order page shows the date, which matters for a gift.

Which one should I get?

  • A gift for someone new to radio: the XHDATA D-219 for simple, or the Tecsun PL-330 if they'll stick with it.
  • You want to hear ham radio too: anything with SSB, like the PL-330, D-808 or Skywave SSB 2.
  • For camping and emergencies: the C.Crane Skywave SSB 2, for its NOAA weather alerts on AA batteries.
  • For a home listening setup: the Tecsun PL-990x or Sangean ATS-909X2, plus a wire antenna.

Is Black Friday a good time to buy a shortwave radio?

Yes. Many radios sold on Amazon drop in price for Black Friday and Cyber Monday. Check the listing's price history with a tool like camelcamelcamel or Keepa to confirm the discount is real.

What is the best shortwave radio to give as a gift?

The Tecsun PL-330 is the best all-round pick: full shortwave coverage with SSB and synchronous AM in a pocket-size radio. For a low-cost stocking stuffer, the XHDATA D-219 is simple and runs on AA batteries.

Do I need SSB?

Only if you want to hear ham radio and other voice traffic that uses single sideband. For international broadcast stations, a radio without SSB is fine.

Do I need an antenna?

Every portable has a built-in telescopic antenna, but a few meters of wire clipped to the antenna jack is the cheapest upgrade and often improves reception a lot.
